notes: All 41 printed asks are retained in 39 separately marked tasks. Q5(a,b,c) shares one 25D award. Both Q6A and Q6B are included at 25 marks each. The three Q7(b)(ii) bullets each have a separately published 5C award.

Paper 2 has its own Foundation ladders: 25D [0,15,18,22,25], 15D [0,6,9,12,15], 20D [0,8,12,16,20], 20C [0,15,17,20], 10C [0,5,7,10]. Only Q8(a)(ii,iii,iv), Q8(b)(i,ii) and Q8(c) are starred. Q8(a)(iv) follows detailed page 56, where the star is present despite its omission from summary page 47.

Q5(b) contains a model-solution error: x=2 is substituted for the printed point B(6,8). The point is on the line, since both sides equal 16. The card labels this correction while preserving the original scheme unchanged.

Q3(a) accepts no key, unordered leaves and stems in either direction. Q6B(d) retains both original angle methods. Q7(a)(iii) retains the complete histogram, including the interval-boundary legend. Q8(c) requires three whole metres after adding 5% to 280 cm.

Original diagrams, tables, construction lines and typeset solutions are retained. Both geometry routes, all required prompts and all separately awarded shirt probabilities are independently practicable.
